title: Why do you watch movies, even though they are fake?

commenti.body:
>real action not phoney nonsense.

What constitute "real action"? John Wick? Sicario? WWE? Spoiler: it's all just as fake as Captain America's flying shield. Tailored for your sense. It's the art. Enjoy how people interpret stories. 

If you don't like comic book superhero fantasy sci-fi movies, fine. Just switch to another genre.
you get to experience stories you'll never experience in real life. jeez
I have many friends probably 300 friends they all watch movies
Why do you make posts, even though your writing is fake? This whole post is fake writing about fake thoughts you have about “fake movies”, stop being so fake you fake fake hating fake.
I'm having a hard time believing that you have friends.
